stage: Before any new sheets or generated compositions inspected; production plan pending separate binding.
ownership: Write only research/anchor-return/independent-review; no generation, selection mutation or prior delivery writes.

original_anchor_bindings.observed_drawing_system: Economical tapered ink and restrained angular face; cool luminous depth behind a clean, long fashion silhouette. Dense city can support scale without copying every floor reflection. Avoid treating armor density or grimacing as the style.
Warm outlined painting, angular color/light planes, expressive thick brows and lively asymmetry; saturated cloth and pale masonry. Not flat vector art and not a glossy Nightglass recolor.
Matte opaque brush shapes, subdued earthy paint, selective scratchy edges, substantial face/body and warm mechanical weight. Do not polish every surface into smooth cel-shaded plastic.
Coarse black/white brush masses, broken dry-brush edges, heavy adult facial planes and a single pink accent. Preserve material and ink character; control busy reflected water separately.
Energetic nib contours, directional hatching, muscular gesture, white negative space and sparse red. Its finer line-based modeling differs from06’s coarse brush-mass construction.
Engraved sepia linework follows curvature and models volumes; dark/light hatch density separates forms. Fewer well-placed hatch bands can calm it, but removing the engraving defeats the treatment.
Thin fairly even contour, broad flat warm color, simplified appealing eyes/nose and spacious architecture. Preserve restrained line economy; do not add glossy dimensional armor rendering.

Rounded volumes, oversized expressive eyes/mouth, bold eyebrows, playful scale and painted color masses. Muscular adults can remain broad and elastic; avoid shrinking everyone into the same narrow heroic face.

Soft near-real facial gradients and elegant slender silhouette; translucent veined petals, luminous hollow center and restrained monochrome with dark red ground. Opaque ivory armor and hard cel face planes are a substantive drift.

criteria.test: Compare actual line, edge, facial construction, shading, material and space against the original anchor. Palette, costume and style labels alone do not demonstrate transfer. New adult identities are allowed; copying an anchor person is not the fidelity test.

Read expressions, gesture, silhouette and composition for charisma, menace, warmth and felt impact. Grip correctness alone does not establish appeal. Keep distinctive powers and target reactions rather than substituting a repeated airborne pose.

Track preparation, commitment, contact, counter, reversal, consequence and recovery through actual eight-beat images. Identify source, path, target and resulting body/environment change. Effects are not proof of contact. Preserve geography, screen direction and available exits; captions cannot supply missing construction.

Trace anatomical hands to shoulders, continuous weapon construction, actor/creature counts, grip and weight support. Follow exact injury side, gear damage and persistent material marks from first appearance to aftermath. A compact sheet is a hypothesis until actual pixels establish it; sheet defects must not become invisible defaults.

Judge floor/water/foliage competition at native and actual phone size. Quiet microtexture while retaining medium-defining brush or hatch marks, material distinction, contact shadows, depth and scale. A dry floor becoming polished or reflective is a material change even if smoother.

Compare exact source and F at matched size for actual relief and regressions in face, silhouette, anatomy, contacts, force accents, damage and world depth. A smoother image that deletes a needed chip or impact accent is partial or rejected; do not repair anatomy or restage the shot under finishing.

Inspect actual complete uncaptioned phone sequences, not only isolated native art or screenshot receipts. Assess framing variation, transitions, readable small figures and fatigue from repeated patterns. Distinguish AI-observed reading risks from uncollected owner comfort feedback.

preflight_caveats: Original anchors themselves contain busy floors and backgrounds; recover their drawing systems without reproducing every distracting mark.
Supplemental sheets can inadvertently homogenize faces, bodies, creature joints or weapon styles across routes. Review their actual construction before propagation.
Editable contact layouts and state cards establish intended relationships, not final-pixel compliance. Distinguish each shot’s current state from future damage to avoid early contamination.
An eight-beat sequence requires sustained state transitions, varied reversals and a visible cost/recovery; eight attractive isolated illustrations are insufficient.

Recent EN drift is a hypothesis to test: NG heavier armored sameness, BP harder opaque creature/face construction, IO smoothing toward cel metal, ST narrowing away from rounded original shape language.
Keep factual disagreements, source hashes and exposure disclosures. Never turn global praise into per-image ratings or canon.
review_evidence: Native images and actual phone source/F pairs plus uncaptioned sequences. SHA receipts verify identity of evidence but cannot establish visual quality.
